title: Read the fine details because they are scamming you
body: I bought the app for €1 to see what I’d be able to use it and was it worth it and I did not use it. I did not find it was Good. I applied to cancel the subscription on the third day and I assumed that it was cancelled and then the next day I was charged the full €30 or for the subscription for the month I appealed this and messaged the app and asked for a refund and I was told that with their subscription policy I was not entilled to refund because it was not within the timeframe. I’ve not used the app. I have not used it since I’ve been charged for it. I actually did cancel my subscription but they sent a second email to double confirm your cancellation which to me is actually scamming people I got charged €30. I’m not getting refund. This app is absolutely terrible. Customer service terrible I would not recommend!
author: SMcG28

title: Not impressed
body: One annual subscription and one 6 month subscription - same user, same email address, 2 subscriptions? Can’t get my money back for the 6 month one even though there was an annual one in place.
author: FrankIre

title: Unauthorised transaction, no refund
body: Avoid this app and the web-site. I have paid for a free 3-day trial to see how it goes, and immediately was charged for some pdf-file - which is useless by the way for extra 30$ (you can have three decent books for that price) - without any authorisation. I am going to raise it with my bank anyway. The company claims it is in-app purchase though by the time the amount was withdrawn I haven’t even uploaded the app to my phone since I just subscribed on the web-site. EU law applies - 14-day refund for any unwanted product. Absolute disgrace and bad business practice - going to report them to EU customer care as well.
author: User529054/2024

title: SCAM!
body: Under EU Law I’m entitled to a full refund within 14 days they acknowledged this when I requested my refund. I am yet to recover the money.
author: neilmpb

title: SCAM!
body: I purchased a free trial and was immediately charged not only once but a few times. I then tried to cancel my subscription through the app and it said my registered email wasn’t recognised even though it was correct. I contacted the help desk weeks ago and still haven’t got a response or anyone to help me cancel this - I was just charged another payment this morning - Do not sign up if you want to avoid a mess like this! It is a SCAM!
